title: Members
description: The people who belong to this tenant, the roles they hold and what they can see. Invite someone, change their access, or disable a leaver.
inviteDescription: They get a one-time link to join. Until they accept, their membership stays disabled.
editAccessDescription: Changes take effect the next time the member's session refreshes, within a few minutes.
rolesDescription: What the member may do. You can give only roles whose authorities you hold yourself.
scopeDescription: The whole tenant, or only the devices of chosen customers and groups, and their data.
scopeCustomersDescription: The member sees the devices assigned to these customers, the data recorded while each customer owned the device, and the dashboards shared with them.
scopeGroupsDescription: The member sees the devices in these groups while they are in them, the data recorded while they were, and the dashboards shared with the groups. Only groups used as an access scope are offered: if a group is missing, enable it as an access scope on the group's page.
scopeGroupsEmpty: No access-scope group matches. Enable a group as an access scope on its page.
scopeLimitedHint: Choose at least one customer or group, up to {{max}} in all.
scopeTooLong: A member can be limited to at most {{max}} customers and groups in all. Remove some.
groupAccessDescription: A member can be limited to an access-scope group. They then see the devices in the group while they are in it, the data recorded while they were, and the dashboards shared with the group. A device whose attributes move it into or out of the group appears or disappears for them without anyone editing the member.
groupAccessEnabled: This group is an access scope. Members can be limited to it on the Members page, and dashboards can be shared with it.
groupAccessDisabled: This group is not an access scope.
groupAccessDisabledToast: {{token}} is no longer an access scope. Members limited to it see none of its devices.
groupAccessDisableConfirm: Members limited to {{token}} will stop seeing its devices at their next request, and it can no longer be chosen for a member or a dashboard share. Their memberships and the dashboards already shared with it are kept.
groupAccessLimit: A tenant can have at most {{max}} access-scope groups. Stop using another group as an access scope first.
groupAccessNotDevices: Only a group of devices can be an access scope.
groupAccessStatic: Only a dynamic group, whose members are chosen by a filter, can be an access scope. Save a filter as a group from the Browse screen.
groupAccessUnpublished: This dynamic group has not been published yet. Publish its filter to fix the members an access scope follows, then use it as an access scope.
groupAccessPublishStale: Someone else changed this group while you had it open. Its current state is shown now; publish again if you still want to.
invitationIssued: Send this link to {{email}}. Opening it lets them set a password, or sign in with an existing account, and join this tenant.
invitationShownOnce: This link is shown only once and cannot be read back later. It is valid for 7 days. If it is lost, reissue the invitation, which stops this link working.
managedByIdpHint: This membership is managed by the tenant's identity provider and cannot be changed here.
disabledToast: {{email}} disabled. Their access ends at their next session refresh.
removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this tenant? Their account is kept, and they can be invited again.
invitationsDescription: Every invitation issued in this tenant, newest first.
rolesPageDescription: The roles that can be given to this tenant's members. Roles defined by the platform operator can be assigned but not changed here; roles defined by this tenant can be edited.
roleNotFound: No role with token "{{token}}" can be assigned in this tenant.
instanceRoleReadOnly: This role is defined by the platform operator. It can be assigned to members, but only the operator can change it.
authoritiesHint: Authorities you do not hold yourself are greyed out: no one can grant more than they have.
authorityAllHint: Every tenant authority, including ones added later.
authorityNotHeld: You do not hold this authority, so you cannot grant it.
deleteRoleConfirm: Delete the role {{token}}? A role still held by a member cannot be deleted.
customerUsersDescription: The people who can sign in and see only this customer's devices and their data.
customerUsersTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} users. This customer has more than the console lists here; the rest are on the Members page, which lists every member of the tenant a page at a time.
customerUsersEmpty: Nobody is limited to this customer yet. Invite a user to give the customer its own access.
customerDevicesEmpty: No devices are assigned to this customer. Assign one from the device's Assignment tab.
acceptIntro: You have been invited to join a tenant. Choose a password for a new account, or sign in with the account the invitation was sent to.
acceptNoCode: This link is incomplete. Open the whole invitation link you were sent, or ask for a new one.
acceptSsoButton: Sign in with SSO and accept
acceptAsSignedIn: You are signed in. Accept the invitation with this account.
acceptNotYou: Not you? Use a different account
acceptChooseTenant: Invitation accepted. Choose the tenant to open.
errorEscalation: You cannot give an authority you do not hold yourself.
errorSelfModification: You cannot change your own membership. Ask another administrator.
errorLastAdmin: That would leave nobody able to manage members.
errorManagedByIdp: This membership is managed by the tenant's identity provider and cannot be changed here.
errorReadOnly: This role is defined by the platform operator and cannot be changed here.
errorAlreadyMember: That person is already a member of this tenant.
errorUnknownRoleOrScope: A chosen role no longer exists, or this person is no longer a member. Reload and try again.
errorRoleTokenTaken: A role with that token already exists.
errorLimitExceeded: A member can be limited to at most 16 customers and groups in all.
errorRoleInUse: This role is still held by a member. Take it away from every member first.
errorInvalidInvitation: This invitation cannot be used. It may have expired, been revoked or already been used, or it was sent to a different account. Ask for a new one.
errorSsoRequired: This tenant requires single sign-on. Sign in with SSO to accept the invitation.
